column5: PROMOTED, and the row it replaces had geometry only. MEASURED ON ALL THREE AXES and confirmed against a SECOND 1440 draw, 10335-234584 inside 10335-234351, which is identical value for value - so the numbers are two independent reads, not one. GEOMETRY rail 274x224, a column with 16 between the heading and the list; heading 24 tall with its text 142 wide; list 274x184 holding four rows at y=0/48/96/144, so a 40-tall row on an 8 pitch; the row is 4 of padding above and below a 32-tall body, which is what makes it 40; avatar 32x32 at x=0 with the handle at x=40, an 8 gap; the Follow pill 70x30 at x=204, and 204+70 closes the 274 exactly, radius 8, padding 6/16. Every one of those already shipped. TYPE AND COLOUR did not, and they are three separate defects. (1) The heading rendered in CORMORANT GARAMOND: index.css:727-733 puts every h1-h6 outside a dialog on the display serif and this is a bare aside heading, against a frame that reads Manrope Regular 400 18/24 at -0.72px. It also ran 16px at weight 500. Now font-manrope text-[18px]/[24px] font-normal tracking-[-0.04em]. (2) The Follow pill took the Button default, bg-primary, and --primary is #2DEDAD (index.css:493) against a drawn #56C7F3 with a #001615 label; its label ran 12/16 against Manrope Regular 14/18. Now bg-sky-blue text-[#001615] text-[14px]/[18px] font-normal, and sky-blue resolves #56C7F3 (design-tokens.ts:244 maps it off accentColors.skyBlue). (3) No text carried the -4% every one of the three styles declares. ★ THE RAIL IS DARK ON /social TODAY and this row does not claim otherwise: SocialFeed.tsx omits the suggestions prop entirely and DiscoverFeed reads undefined as do-not-render, so the component has no live pixels until a suggestion source exists. It IS imported and rendered by DiscoverFeed.tsx:313, so this is an unsupplied prop and not an unmounted file. ORACLE SuggestedFollows.figma.test.tsx, which did not exist - a grep for the name across every .test.ts/.tsx in src/ returned zero against a positive control of three for StoryRail. Five cases, each class assertion running over ALL FOUR rows behind a toHaveLength, because every row carries its own copy of the ramp. MUTATION-CHECKED eight times, each proved red alone and restored: font-manrope -> md:font-manrope, text-[18px]/[24px] -> [240px], text-[12px]/[16px] -> [160px], text-[14px]/[18px] -> [180px], bg-sky-blue -> bg-sky-blue/90, font-normal -> md:font-normal, w-[70px] -> w-[700px], space-y-2 -> space-y-2.5. Every one is EXTENDING, so a substring check would have passed all eight. ONE DEPARTURE, STATED ON THE COMPONENT: the frame's row is justify-between with no gap, so a handle wide enough would run into the pill; the row keeps 8 between them and truncates 8px earlier instead.

column1: Bonding strip [10335-234455]
column5: PROMOTED. THE STRIP HAD ONE SET OF VALUES WHERE THE FRAME DRAWS THREE, AND ONE COLOUR WHERE IT DRAWS TWO. Read at all three widths - 11442-177782 (375), 11442-165505 (768), 10335-234455 (1440) - geometry, type and fill each taken from the node rather than inferred from a neighbour. GEOMETRY strip height 14 / 16 / 18 over a flat 10px bar on a flat 8 gap; the bar is Frame 506, two rects ONE PIXEL apart, the fill rounded 4 on its left corners only and the remainder rounded 4 on its right only; the arithmetic closes at 1440 as 59 + 8 + 380 + 8 + 51 = 506 and at 375 as 50 + 8 + 233 + 8 + 44 = 343. TYPE both labels are MULISH Regular 400, the numeric face, 12/14 then 14/16 then 14/18, all at -4%. The 768 step is 14 and not 12: the string reads 59 wide at 768 and 59 at 1440 against 50 at 375, while 6 comments on the same card reads 65 / 65 / 75, so the two ramps genuinely differ and a size-only guess off the sibling would have been wrong. COLOUR the left label is #17F9B4, the same mint the bar fills with, and the right label is #FFFFFF; the code painted BOTH text-muted-foreground, which is #B3B9CC. FIXED: h-[14px] md:h-[16px] xl:h-[18px] on the strip; font-mulish text-xs/[14px] md:text-sm/[16px] xl:text-sm/[18px] tracking-[-0.04em] shared by the two labels; text-alien-green-bright and text-foreground on the ends; the bar rebuilt as the frame's two siblings with gap-px and rounded-l-[4px] / rounded-r-[4px]. The clip the old single track relied on is not needed - the fraction is already clamped to 0..1 upstream. ★ NOTHING ON TODAY'S FEED REACHES THIS BRANCH: feedSource.ts:82 sets bonding to null on every mapped row with the comment that no curve data is present, so this is the frame's spec made right for the day the data arrives, not a live pixel change. Said plainly rather than left to be discovered. ORACLE PostCard.figma.test.tsx - the existing bar case was rewritten to the two-rect structure and a new case pins the height ramp, the family, the three type steps, the tracking and BOTH colours, asserting the left and right ends separately so one cannot mask the other. MUTATION-CHECKED thirteen times, each alone and restored: h-[14px]/[140px], md:h-[16px]/[160px], font-mulish -> md:font-mulish, the three type steps each to a ten-times leading, tracking -> md: variant, each label colour -> md: variant, gap-px -> md:gap-px, rounded-l-[4px] -> [40px], rounded-r-[4px] -> [40px], and the fill given all four corners. git diff --stat then reported the file unchanged before the real edit.
